Mrs. Fisher: Nice salmon you caught. Just be careful of zombie salmon.
You: Zombie salmon? 
Mrs. Fisher: After successful spawning salmon’s life cycle is over. The fish is exhausted and just waits for death to come. 
Mrs. Fisher: You can catch a zombie salmon upstream, during fall and early winter. It will be pale, very skinny and with ragged fins.
Mrs. Fisher: They are not good to eat, so release them as soon as you catch them.
You: Alright, thanks for the tip.
